notes.title: Minor 4K fix + crude VR implementation
notes.notes:
New game / Profile setup window now placed in the center of screen with 4k resolution

Crude VR implementation (Have SteamVR running when starting the game)
Note: Bad image quality (lack of anti-aliasing), no VR controller input
(Our VR headset broke a year ago so there has not been further development since)

Seat height adjustment - hold right mouse button and scroll up/down
(scroll only to adjust seat forward/backward, middle mouse button+scroll to reset)

notes.title: Download/install fix
notes.notes:
If you previously had trouble downloading/installing the game, please try again now.
Some texture files that were causing the issue have been removed.

If you are still having problems, try uninstalling and redownloading the game.
If that does not help, please report in the discussions / "Cant download the game" thread.

notes.title: 2022 update!
notes.notes:
[b]Online play[/b]
Drive with your friends and other people!
Note: This is just basic, still work in progress implementation, please be prepared for some unexpected issues. There are also no online races or other fancy features at this time.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- Blank 1st person view after returning from world map (and other random occasions) fixed
- Throttle/clutch/brake mapping (inputs not working after mapping) fixed
- Crash to Desktop upon activating found "treasure" fixed
- Controller deadzone fix
- Race start does not damage vehicle anymore
- Negative vehicle prices bug fix
- Launcher: does not try to connect to the discontinued website anymore
- Other minor fixes

[b]Visual Fixes[/b]
- Addressed some reflection flickering, plant animation and FOV stretching issues
- Some cockpit FOV effect issues fixed when looking around in speed
- Head bumping up and down limited down in cockpit view
- Vehicles do not appear to float in the air anymore
- RF-48 Spider cockpit camera position adjusted
- Sandy Peaks, Sandy Rocks and Meadow Park locations updated
- Minor visual/detail updates around the map

[b]Other improvements[/b]
- World map can be now dragged when holding mouse button
- World map can now be interacted with a controller
- Number of simultanous night lights increased
- User interface now scaled up for 4k resolution

[b]A message from the developer[/b]
Unfortunately due to personal life matters the development of this game came to an halt a few years ago.
But I have now picked it up again with new energy. But please note that I have an day job and I'm a single parent, so my time is limited and thus development will be slow.
